mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name, u.gender as user_gender, u.phone as user_phone, u.email as user_email, c.class_no, c.class_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.id ORDER BY s.student_no

SELECT s.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name, u.gender as user_gender, u.phone as user_phone, u.email as user_email, c.class_no, c.class_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name, u.gender as user_gender, u.phone as user_phone, u.email as user_email, c.class_no, c.class_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.id WHERE s.student_no = #{studentNo}

SELECT s.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name, u.gender as user_gender, u.phone as user_phone, u.email as user_email, c.class_no, c.class_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT s.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name, u.gender as user_gender, u.phone as user_phone, u.email as user_email, c.class_no, c.class_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.id WHERE s.dormitory_id = #{dormitoryId} ORDER BY s.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student(user_id, student_no, class_id, dormitory_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{classId}, #{dormitoryId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET student_no = #{studentNo}, class_id = #{classId}, dormitory_id = #{dormitoryId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
